title: Gluten-Free Turkish Lamb Kebab
description: A traditional Turkish-inspired kebab made with lamb, served with a side of fresh spring vegetables.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, thinly sliced
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim excess fat

ingredients.name: Jagged onions, sliced
ingredients.notes: Separate the rings to prevent burning

ingredients.name: Turkish doner spice blend
ingredients.notes: Adjust the spice level to taste

ingredients.name: Salt and black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use coarse salt for better flavor

ingredients.name: Spring vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, cherry tomatoes)
ingredients.notes: Choose a variety of colors for a visually appealing dish

ingredients.name: Spring oil or olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral-tasting oil for grilling

ingredients.name: Lemon wedges
ingredients.notes: Serve with the kebab for added flavor

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb, sliced onions, minced garlic, and Turkish doner spice blend.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with spring oil or olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebab for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Meanwhile, grill the spring vegetables for 5-7 minutes per side, or until tender.
Serve the kebab with the grilled spring vegetables and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Let the kebab rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
